overview: The Council approved the installation of the Aqua Hawk water leak detection system and mandated a 30-day response window for parking ticket appeals. Members also scheduled a committee meeting to mitigate traffic and safety impacts caused by the Craddock Bridge refurbishing project.

items.title: Aqua Hawk Leak Detection System
items.summary: Approved the purchase and installation of the Aqua Hawk system to monitor individual water meters for leaks and reduce costs for ratepayers.

items.title: Granada Scary Walk Run Announcement
items.summary: Announced the annual Granada Scary Walk Run scheduled for September 26, 2015, at the American Legion.

items.title: Parking Appeal Response Reform
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring Republic Parking to respond to appeals within 30 days and requested a comprehensive report on staffing and appeal statistics.

items.title: Chevalier Theater Management Petition
items.summary: Tabled a petition regarding management and discrimination issues at the Chevalier Theater pending a legal opinion from the city solicitor.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Construction and Bus Relocation
items.summary: Referred a proposal to relocate Medford Square bus stops to a committee meeting with MassDOT and MBTA officials to address construction-related traffic congestion.

items.title: AC Hotels Marriott Signage Approval
items.summary: Approved non-conforming signage for the AC Hotels Marriott at Station Landing, including a provision for a six-month review of the sign's illumination impact.

items.title: Common Victualler License Approvals
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Italia di Gusto at 24 High Street and Chicken and Rice Guys at 64 Salem Street.

items.title: Sidewalk Audits and Infrastructure Lighting
items.summary: Referred citizen requests for sidewalk repairs and improved lighting near bridge construction to the Department of Public Works and the Electrical Department.

items.title: Routine Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Congratulated local organizations and hall of fame inductees while offering condolences to the families of several recently deceased community members, including former Councilor John Toomey.

items.title: Highway Department Recognition
items.summary: Formally thanked the Highway Department for the prompt completion of road striping and handicap space painting on Winthrop and High Streets.
